scope: Finite 10,000-zero truncated-block active-window flow-time approximations only; not a measurement, estimate, upper bound, or lower bound for Lambda.
event_policy: Stop at min gap = 1e-3 times the initial min gap; add the two-body tail epsilon^2/8 to report a zero-gap time estimate.
